verdicts.reason: Both break the original's structure in the same ways: the green circle is split off from the can and the body copy sits on top of it. The SOLSTICE wordmark lands below the headline, so the reading order is wrong. The CTA and the two badges are squashed into a strip where they almost touch, and the tiny SUMMER ONLY badge competes with the CTA. B is worse because its body copy is jammed against the left canvas edge (about 4px margin), the circle is cut off on the left, and about 160px on the right is left empty. A at least keeps even side margins, though it wastes about 80px at the far left.
